It sounds like excessive exposure to television and society has
zapped out attention span and will.  Your best advice is to ignore
anything in the newspapers because the media continue to show that
they just don't get it.

76. In response to the arguments of this section someone will say,
"Society must find a way to give people the opportunity to go through
the power process." For such people the value of the opportunity is
destroyed by the very fact that society gives it to them. What they
need is to find or make their own opportunities. As long as the
system GIVES them their opportunities it still has them on a leash.
To attain autonomy they must get off that leash.
